title: Composed supervisory control: Bounded up/down inventory counter -> Four-level alarm priority encoder

inputs.name: A_Capacity
inputs.description: Subsystem A: Maximum count, assumed positive

outputs.name: A_Conflict
outputs.description: Subsystem A: Add and Remove rose together

outputs.name: B_Active
outputs.description: Subsystem B: At least one reportable condition

outputs.name: B_Level
outputs.description: Subsystem B: 0 none, 1 info, 2 warning, 3 trip, 4 emergency

scan.initialization: fresh function-block instance for every test case

assumptions: Subsystem A: A_Capacity remains constant during a test and is positive.
Subsystem A: Each test starts from a fresh function-block instance.
Subsystem B: The function block is called exactly once per PLC scan.
Subsystem B: Inputs are sampled at scan start and outputs are checked at scan end.
Subsystem B: Each test starts from a fresh function-block instance.
Subsystem A executes before the supervisory latch and subsystem B within each scan.
Requirements inherited from subsystem B apply only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE.
When subsystem B is isolated, its externally visible outputs take their type-safe defaults.

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: A lone rising A_AddItem edge increments A_Count when below A_Capacity.
requirements.property: G((rose(A_AddItem) AND !rose(A_RemoveItem) AND prev(A_Count)<A_Capacity AND !A_Reset) -> A_Count=prev(A_Count)+1)

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: A lone rising A_RemoveItem edge decrements A_Count when above zero.
requirements.property: G((rose(A_RemoveItem) AND !rose(A_AddItem) AND prev(A_Count)>0 AND !A_Reset) -> A_Count=prev(A_Count)-1)

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: Simultaneous rising edges shall leave A_Count unchanged and set A_Conflict for one scan.
requirements.property: G((rose(A_AddItem) AND rose(A_RemoveItem) AND !A_Reset) -> ((A_Count=prev(A_Count)) AND A_Conflict))

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Count shall remain within zero and A_Capacity; A_Empty and A_Full reflect the boundaries.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Reset shall clear A_Count and A_Conflict.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Emergency shall always produce B_Level 4 and B_Active TRUE, even when B_Suppress is TRUE.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: When not suppressed, the highest B_Active condition shall determine B_Level.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Suppress shall force B_Level 0 and B_Active FALSE when B_Emergency is FALSE.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Level 0 shall be equivalent to B_Active FALSE.
A TRUE A_Empty shall latch CrossReady unless CrossReset is TRUE in the same scan.
CrossReset shall have priority, clear CrossReady, and isolate every subsystem-B output to its type-safe default.
requirements.property: G(CrossReset -> (!CrossReady AND NOT B_Active AND B_Level=0)) AND G((NOT (SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady)) -> (NOT B_Active AND B_Level=0))

requirements.text: Once set, CrossReady shall remain TRUE after the subsystem-A signal falls, until a later CrossReset scan.
Subsystem B may execute only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE; CrossBlocked is TRUE exactly when SubsystemBEnable is requested without CrossReady.

composition.runtime_design: one stateful primary subsystem plus one stateless Boolean subsystem

provenance.origin: deterministic ordered composition of independently specified base behaviors
